name: medicore-hms
description: MediCore HMS - intentionally vulnerable hospital management system (academic security lab, synthetic data only)

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose run --rm backend npm run reset -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
